is refused. CI exercises the tested profile matrix (`runtime/compatibility.json`)
plus the `next` d"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ist-tag. The bundled runtime is
**DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**, including the upstream cross-process session w"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"he bundled runtime is
**DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**, including the upstream cross-process session write lock."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Runtime selection has exactly two rules (Martty issue #157):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Standalone** (`dsh-acp` bin): the packaged runtime is always used —

(or the literal value `bundled`) selects an installation instead, and is
refused with "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"a message naming the version found, its source, and the
supported range when it falls outside it.
- "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"**Plugin mode** (`dsh plugin add`, Martty launched as a dsh plugin): the
hosting dsh is the runtime,"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" checked against the same range at mount time;
an out-of-range host fails with the same refusal mess"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"cked against the same range at mount time;

- **Permission presets as session modes** "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"— `read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access`, each a named `{sandbox, approval}` pair re"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"corded as a durable session fact (also exposed as a config option for clients that only render those"},{"id":"p14s9","text":").
